    1. RainbowGumLog4jProvider()

Class RainbowGumLog4jProvider

java.lang.Object
org.apache.logging.log4j.spi.Provider
io.jstach.rainbowgum.log4j.RainbowGumLog4jProvider
@ServiceProvider(org.apache.logging.log4j.spi.Provider.class) public final class RainbowGumLog4jProvider extends org.apache.logging.log4j.spi.Provider
Registered via ServiceLoader (META-INF/services/ org.apache.logging.log4j.spi.Provider), not the older META-INF/log4j-provider.properties mechanism: decompiling this version of log4j-api shows that path's Provider(Properties, URL, ClassLoader) constructor unconditionally sets versions to null, which ProviderUtil/validVersion then rejects outright ("Ignoring provider for incompatible version"), confirmed empirically: a properties-file-registered provider is silently never selected. The subclass-plus-ServiceLoader path used here still populates Provider.getVersions() correctly (from the Provider(Integer, String, Class) constructor called below), so it is picked up correctly.
